purpose: Research on kidney function in chronic kidney disease to improve follow-up care.
question: What is the latest kidney function of patients with chronic kidney disease, by sex?
definitions: Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Kidney function = eGFR; use each patient's most recent eGFR value. Patients without an eGFR value are left out.
Low kidney function = latest eGFR below 45.
Report per sex: patients with an eGFR value, their mean latest eGFR, those with low kidney function, and the percentage with low kidney function, one decimal.
